name: seed-new-project
query: I'm starting a new project under vault/PROJECTS/ - set up the standard notes folder for it
why: A new project vault where none exists is the scaffolder's job.

name: lint-existing-vault
query: Does PROJECTS/WIDGET still conform to the vault contract? The graph tool has started returning nothing for it.
why: Conformance and a downstream reader misbehaving are the linter's job.

name: template-for-meetings-and-questions
query: Give my hobby project a proper home for meeting notes, open questions and learnings, the way my other projects have
why: The vault shape for any domain, named by its families.

name: fill-in-partial-vault
query: This project folder has an index and a BRD but none of the notes files - add whatever is missing without touching what's there

name: adopt-loose-folder
query: I've got a folder for my side project with meetingnotes.txt, a couple of meeting transcripts, a SOW, some ticket exports and scratch notes - make it work like my other project vaults
why: Mapping an existing folder of loose material into the vault shape is the adoption step.

name: grown-vault-reading
query: The meeting and chat notes in my project vault are thousands of lines now - how should agents be reading it without loading whole files?
why: How a grown vault is read is part of the vault contract, which points at markdown-kg.

name: sprint-board-not-vault
query: What should the epics, features and stories be for the ingestion platform stabilization?
why: Board content is sprint-board's job; the vault only hosts the file.

name: markdown-kg-not-vault
query: What links to notes-learnings, and how are the meeting notes connected to the BRD?
why: Graph traversal over an existing vault is markdown-kg's job.

name: generic-obsidian-note
query: Write me an Obsidian note about sourdough starters with a callout and a couple of wikilinks
why: Authoring a single note is the obsidian skill; no project vault is involved.

name: knowledge-base-merge
query: Merge the certified research on vector databases into the knowledge base
why: The knowledge base and certification flow are outside the vault.

name: repo-docs-vault
query: I'm the only one on this code project. Set up a notes vault in its docs/ folder for meetings, decisions and stories.
why: A single user's vault inside a code repo is the --into home.
